findings.name: Version 258.13.0.0
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud for Customer Engagement features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description Visit Management | When a default channel was set, the Channel field could be empty causing an error that the visit is already signed and locked when trying to submit the visit. | If a default channel is set, the Channel field now retains that setting. Even if a sample limit template wasn't assigned to a product, limit validation would still be performed, resulting in an error. | Sample limits are no longer checked if a sample limit template isn't assigned to a product. It was possible to submit a Visit with a child visit that contained a restricted product. | Attempting to submit a Visit that has a child visit with a restricted product displays an error. In certain circumstances it was possible for a Reaction Type Value to be changed from blank to Positive automatically, preventing the visit from being saved. | A blank Reaction Type Value is no longer changed by the app automatically. A rep could delete an attendee using a quick action after the visit was signed. Also, there was no warning this happened. | Deleting an attendee after a visit is signed now displays a message that the record is signed and locked. Searching for accounts was too slow. | Searching for accounts is now significantly faster. However, as a result of a logic change to improve performance, account search now returns accounts that match the Account name and not the Written and Phonetic name. Home Page | In the Up Next agenda on the home page, the event date didn’t match the event’s start and end times when the user's timezone changed, and the same date sometimes appeared in multiple sections. On desktop, multi-day events weren’t split into multiple events in the agenda. | Event dates now match the corresponding start and end times, duplicate date sections are removed, and multi-day events are split into multiple entries. Additionally, the event time format no longer includes seconds. In the Up Next agenda, Time Off Territory events show the record name instead of the type of event. | Time Off Territory events now show the type of event, for example, Personal Absence or Training. In the Up Next component on the home page, all day general events didn’t appear on the correct date. | All day general events now show up on the correct date in the Up Next agenda on the home page. Calendar | The Visit preview fails to load and returns an unexpected error even when attendee records are correctly associated with the visit. | Fixed the underlying logic to show the preview for valid visit records. Medical Inquiry | When the MultiEntityCreateOverride component was configured for the New button on the Inquiry object and users tried to create a new inquiry, an error occurred. | Users can now create a new inquiry when the MultiEntityCreateOverride component is configured. Searching for response delivery preferences took longer than expected and required multiple clicks. On clicking the Contact Point Address, Contact Point Email, and Contact Point Phone column headers, the results couldn’t be sorted. | After the fix, the search and the sort functionalities are working as expected. Email | Email consent checks didn't check the EffectiveFromDate and EffectiveToDate fields on Communication Subscription Consent records, meaning that emails could be sent to people whose consent had expired or hadn't yet started. | Now emails are sent only when valid consent is present, respecting the Effective From Date and Effective To Date on Communication Subscription Consent records. Inventory Management | The creation of inventory operation records would fail if the related User Additional Info record didn’t have a product return address. | Now inventory operation records can be created irrespective of whether the product return address field is populated or not.

findings.name: Version 258.12.0.0
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud for Customer Engagement features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description Visit Management | The Visit page didn't load for Life Sciences Field Medical users. | The Visit page now loads correctly for Life Sciences Field Medical users. A Product Item without a Production Batch ID wouldn't display in Samples. | Product Items with Production Batch IDs are now displayed correctly in Samples. Setting a Document ID on a Visit would cause the Place ID and Shipping Address to display incorrectly and submitting the Visit would fail with the message "We couldn't perform the action because this visit is signed and locked." | You can now submit a Visit with a Document ID and the Place ID and Shipping Address display correctly. When the "Show recent details and product selector" setting is enabled, some products that were displayed in the Product Details sidebar for mobile wouldn't be displayed in the web app. Also, recent products that were displayed in the sidebar weren't displayed in the Product Selector in Visit. | Products are correctly displayed in the Product Details sidebar and in Product Selector for Visit in the web app. The Place ID on the Visit would change to a different ID after submission. | The Place ID displays correctly after the Visit is submitted. A Visit could be saved without a shipping address if the account was changed. | A Visit can no longer be saved without a shipping address. Inventory Management | On the Sample Inventory Management dashboard, users were unable to submit inventory count assessments due to high volume of Inventory Operation records. | The issue has been fixed and users can now submit inventory count assessments even when the volume of Inventory Operation records is high. On the Sample Inventory Management dashboard, in the Inventory Operations section, when users would try to create product requests, the product types displayed would be the API names of the product specification types, instead of the labels. | After the fix, when users try to create product requests, the product types displayed are the labels of the product specification types. General | The Life Sciences Commercial Lightning App didn’t have an icon in the App Launcher. | The Life Sciences Commercial Lightning App now has the same icon as the Life Sciences Cloud Mobile app. Email | Users saw an unhelpful error when the RSVP email address isn’t enabled on the Life Sciences for Customer Engagement Setup page. | Users now see a helpful error informing them that the email RSVP email address isn’t set up yet. Issues occurred when sending emails via the LifeScienceApi global Apex class. For example, attachments weren’t included in emails, and some emails that were marked as canceled were still sent. | Emails that are sent via the LifeScienceApi global Apex class are now sent correctly. Activity Timeline | Clicking Resend Email on the activity timeline incorrectly displayed an error and an incorrect label is shown for the associated action. | Fixed the logic to correctly process attachment IDs during the resend action, allowing the email to be resent without an error. The timeline entry now displays the correct label. Mobile App Setup | The object metadata cache configuration validation incorrectly requires a profile when the Type field is set to Data or Configuration. Additionally, an incorrect validation error is shown requiring an Sobject even when it is selected. | Fixed the validation logic to show relevant errors. The View Assignments action didn’t show the assigned profiles for records on the UI Settings page in the mobile app setup. Additionally, the label of the custom UI component wasn’t populated when a user edits the record. | The profile assignments are now shown when a user clicks the View Assignments action. The custom UI component label is populated in the edit view. When a profile was assigned to an Object Metadata Cache configuration record in the list view, the record was incorrectly being deactivated. | Fixed the underlying issue to ensure that the object metadata cache configurations remain active when profiles are assigned from the list view. When metadata cache is generated after the Community User profile is assigned to all object metadata cache configuration records, the LifeSciMobileMetadataRecord persists indefinitely in the Validating status. | The status of the LifeSciMobileMetadataRecord is now correctly updated to Inactive, resolving the indefinite Validating status issue. Product Management | The LSCAdditionalProductDetails custom field on the Life Science Marketable Product object was not visible in the complete Product Hierarchy view. | The issue has been fixed and the LSCAdditionalProductDetails custom field on the Life Science Marketable Product object is now visible in both the complete and partial Product Hierarchy views. Activity Plan | The Calculate Provider Activity Goal Measures batch job couldn’t be run more than once. | Users can now run the Calculate Provider Activity Goal Measures batch job multiple times. Inventory Management | On the Sample Inventory Management dashboard, users were unable to submit inventory count assessments due to high volume of Inventory Operation records. | The issue has been fixed and users can now submit inventory count assessments even when the volume of Inventory Operation records is high. On the Sample Inventory Management dashboard, in the Inventory Operations section, when users would try to create product requests, the product types displayed would be the API names of the product specification types, instead of the labels. | After the fix, when users try to create product requests, the product types displayed are the labels of the product specification types. Account Address | The Accounts list view fails to load when the Contact Point Address formula in Address Setup contains special characters. | The Accounts list view now loads correctly, displaying accounts and their addresses, even when the Contact Point Address formula in setup contains special characters. Medical Inquiry | After a user submits an inquiry record in the mobile and the app syncs, the status of the record incorrectly changes to “Signed”. | The issue is fixed and now the status of a submitted inquiry record doesn’t change after a sync. Calendar | An unexpected error is shown when the user clicks Cancel on the Delete Events window. | Removed the incorrect validation check that was preventing the window from closing. The Delete Events dialog now closes correctly without an error. The Delete Events window prevents users from selecting and deleting multiple event types simultaneously, restricting the selection to only one type at a time. | Modified the underlying logic to correctly support multi-selection of event types. Users can now select and delete multiple event types in a single operation.

findings.name: Version 258.11.0.0
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud for Customer Engagement features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description Visit Management | From an Attendee Visit, Account Card quick actions (such as Inquiry, Last Visit, Survey , Attendee Visit, and Send Email) didn't work. | Account Card quick actions now work. The Visits to Submit page would sometimes display visits that had already been submitted. | The Visits to Submit page now displays only visits that have not yet been submitted. The Provider Account Territory information job would fail to process some records. | The Provider Account Territory information job now correctly processes all records. Users who didn't manage sample inventory in Life Sciences Cloud would see a warning when signing and submitting a Visit with Samples. | Inventory validation is now performed only for users who manage inventory in Life Sciences Cloud. Use of custom objects and fields would prevent the Visits page from loading. | The Visits page now works correctly with custom objects and fields. The list of products shown in the Samples and Direct to Practitioner sections of Visit Management pages would be different between the web and mobile interfaces. | The list of products shown on web and mobile Visit Management pages is now identical. Users were unable to allocate expenses. | Expenses can now be allocated. The Edit Visitors window would throw a null-pointer exception when no profiles were selected in Visitor Settings. | The Edit Visitors window now works correctly regardless of whether any profiles have been selected in Visitor Settings. Inventory Management | The audit-related user perms, Request audits of multiple Inventory Count Assessment records and Perform audits of Inventory Count Assessment records, were not accessible to the user. | The issue has been resolved and the Request audits of multiple Inventory Count Assessment records and Perform audits of Inventory Count Assessment records user perms are accessible to the user. While acknowledging a product transfer, the Quantity on Hand field in the Product Item record and the Remaining Quantity field in the Product Batch Item record were being updated when users clicked on the Save button. | The issue has been fixed, and the Quantity on Hand field in the Product Item record and the Remaining Quantity field in the Product Batch Item record are updated when users click Submit during the acknowledgment of a product transfer. Users weren’t able to add comments in Inventory Operation records. | The issue has been resolved and users can now add comments in Inventory Operation records. The page layout for Product Disbursement wasn’t visible in the Object Manager. | The page layout for Product Disbursement is now visible in the Object Manager. After a visit is submitted, users couldn’t update the Inventory Count Reference field in the related Product Disbursement record. | The issue is now resolved and users can update the Inventory Count Reference field in the related Product Disbursement record after a visit is submitted. Consent Management | Opening the Consent wizard and attempting to add a new email on the recipient page throws a component execution error when the Communication Subscription record isn’t in the expected status. | The Consent wizard now handles Communication Subscription status changes correctly, and adding a new email no longer triggers the component execution error. Time Off Territory | A visit could be created during a Time Off Territory (TOT) event, bypassing the overlapping rule which should have prevented the creation. | Visit creation is now correctly blocked during a Time Off Territory event. Data change request | A DCR record was not getting created when creating an HCP account or an HCO account using this combination: Update Type = Don’t apply changes immediately and Record Creation Approval = Yes. | The DCR record is now created when using this combination. When users approve or reject data change requests from the internal DCR tab, the status for Healthcare Provider records and Provider Affiliations doesn't change to active or inactive. | The status of the rejected Healthcare Provider records now update to inactive, and approved Provider Affiliation records now update to active when processed from the internal DCR tab. The HealthcareProviderRefetchingBatch job fails with Too many SOQL queries:201 error because the getRecordTypeNameFromSObject method is being called inside a loop in the DCR service handler. | The SOQL query was moved outside the loop to prevent multiple executions, making sure the HealthcareProviderReferencingBatch job runs without exceeding the query limit. Lists and Filters | When users select an account from the Accounts tab and click Select and Add, the selected account isn't shown on the resulting window. | Users can now select and add an account to a new list or an existing list. Some quick actions are missing in the More Actions menu for individual accounts. | The issue was resolved by making sure the quick actions are properly configured and displayed in the More Actions menu for all accounts. Activity Plan | The deprecated Account Activity Goal and Activity Plan Lightning App Builder components were appearing in the Home Page and Account record pages, without being flagged as “Deprecated”. | The deprecated components, Account Activity Goal and Activity Plan, are now flagged as “Deprecated” in the Lightning App Builder. Account Search | The HealthcareProviderFlatteningBatchJob failed due to Salesforce governor limits, specifically the "Too many SOQL rows: 50001" error. | The job was optimized by refining the database queries to fetch only necessary records. Unnecessary queries were further eliminated by skipping the DCR logic, as DCR processing was not required for this job. Account Merge | Merging of accounts was failing because CommSubConsentCmplSnpsht fields were not accessible. | Made the CommSubConsentCmplSnpsht fields accessible and now accounts can be merged. Activity Timeline | Incorrect labels were shown for the values in the Type dropdown on the Activity Timeline tab. | Correct labels are now shown for the values in the Type dropdown. Territory Management Jobs | Duplicate entries of the Territory Management job unexpectedly appeared when a job is run or scheduled. | The child records of the job were filtered out. This ensures that duplicate entries are not shown and only one entry per parent batch job appears. Provider Account Territory Info | The Provider Account Territory Info component’s title showed an inaccurate name. | The component’s title is updated to the correct name, Provider Account Territory Information, to ensure accuracy across the user interface. Calendar | When a visit is created by dragging an account or address to the calendar grid, the territory name isn’t populated. | The territory name is now populated when a visit is created by dragging an account or address to the calendar. When creating a visit from the Calendar, the visit duration incorrectly defaults to 30 minutes even though a specific default duration has been defined. | The visit now correctly uses the defined default visit durations when creating a visit from the Calendar. If a default duration is defined, the defined duration is used. If no default duration is defined, the visit duration defaults to 30 minutes.

findings.name: Version 262.9.0
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description Account Management | An account created in the mobile Search Before Create workflow continued to appear unaligned after its DCR was approved, repeatedly prompting users to align it. | Approved accounts now sync updated territory alignments to mobile, removing unnecessary prompts to realign the account. Creating an account and related records from the offline mobile Search Before Create workflow with approval-on-create disabled created child data change requests without linking them to the parent account request. | Child data change requests for related healthcare providers, addresses, affiliations, and specialties now store the parent account request ID, maintaining proper request hierarchy. Custom Person Account columns in mobile account lists displayed technical field API names instead of field labels, and HCP specialties appeared as API codes rather than display labels. | The mobile app now resolves Person Account field labels from related Contact metadata and displays specialty codes as their configured display names. HCP advanced search could hide configured name fields, mark an optional Name field as required, or return an error for a Name-only search. | Mobile search forms now display Person Account fields consistently with the web experience and provide clear search prompts for first name, last name, or NPI search criteria. Calendar | Dragging visits to create or reschedule them in calendar was slow, triggered frequent calendar refreshes, or applied scheduling conflict rules that differed from the Visit page. | Calendar now uses standard visit validation rules, honors configured warning and error settings, minimizes redundant data processing, and refreshes the calendar efficiently. Event Management | The Managed Event expense grid was cut off on iPad displays, making expense details and allocation controls difficult to view and manage. | The grid now uses responsive column layout and consistent spacing, and the allocation window matches the active app theme. Custom labels and translations for Managed Event participant actions weren't reflected in the mobile app. | Participant action custom labels like Attendee, Colleague, Expert, Non-Profiled Attendee, and Write, now correctly display their configured custom labels. The Managed Event resource workflow displayed addresses for unrelated accounts and included location types not applicable to events. | Addresses are now filtered to the selected account, and account locations are limited to applicable event venues. The record type was missing when creating a Managed Event on iPad, and record type mappings failed to populate or save the corresponding event type. | Available record types now appear correctly during event creation, and selected record type mappings correctly populate and save to the Managed Event record. The affiliation action could remain hidden in the Managed Event attendee view even when HCP-HCO affiliations were enabled. | The mobile app now reads the current Managed Event affiliation setting and displays the affiliation action when configured. The Select Colleague screen could list all active users, including HCP and HCO records that weren't eligible colleagues. | The Select Colleague screen now filters the user list to display only eligible internal user accounts. Managed Event presentations were available only in preview mode, preventing presentation activity and clickstream data from being captured. | Users can now tap presentation thumbnails to open them in Play mode, allowing the app to record presentation activity and clickstream data directly against the event. The Subject lookup for a Managed Event displayed subjects intended for other uses, including base and system-generated records. | The subject lookup now filters out system-generated and non-event records, displaying only subjects configured for Managed Events. The mobile sign-in sheet ignored configured attendee field sets and lock-screen settings. | Signature capture now reads these values directly from the Managed Event configuration, regardless of unrelated feature settings, and displays the configured columns and lock controls. The Distribution Type field in Managed Event expenses displayed a different label on iPad than on the desktop site. | The mobile expense view now uses the current configured field label for a consistent experience across interfaces. The Managed Event Account Attendees window on iPad omitted Search Before Create options, preventing users from creating an account from the attendee workflow. | The attendee search workflow on iPad now incorporates configured search settings and field sets, enabling advanced search and account creation directly from the window. Confirming an HCO or venue resource didn't populate the related location and address on the parent Managed Event. | When a resource reaches confirmed status, its location and address details are copied to the parent Managed Event and preserved across synchronization. Adding a non-profiled attendee could assign an unavailable invited participant response, and adding an attendee could fail because the app couldn't synchronize an address text field. | Attendee creation now uses valid participant-response values and correctly handles attendee address data during synchronization. Users could not add colleagues to a managed event. | Fixed the underlying issue and users can now add colleagues to a managed event. General | URL-addressable Lightning web components (LWC) on home pages or custom tabs failed to render when a namespace was added to a component name more than once. | The mobile app now recognizes names that already include a namespace and consistently resolves the correct component name. Text entered in a rich text area on a dynamically rendered page could be lost when users saved the record on iPad. | The rich text editor now reliably captures and syncs text entries so that edits are preserved and displayed after saving. Pending mobile updates waiting to synchronize were not reapplied after a download sync, causing records to appear to revert to older server values. | Pending local changes are now reapplied immediately after synchronization so edits remain visible until fully processed by the server. Lightning web component (LWC) actions placed in a record highlight panel were not prefetched during metadata synchronization and were unavailable offline. | Metadata synchronization now automatically caches highlight panel component actions, making them available offline. Sales Data | Dashboard report tiles that displayed data in Lightning Experience could appear blank or show no data. | Dashboard requests now use the current supported API behavior, tolerate incomplete component data, and display report tables with corrected sizing and alignment. Surveys | Selecting the survey action from a Managed Event failed because the mobile app used an outdated workflow component name and parameters. | The survey action now connects to current survey components, allowing survey forms to open smoothly from Managed Events. Visit Management | Visit record types on mobile displayed alphabetically or defaulted based on database order rather than following the sort order configured in Visit Record Type Mappings. | The mapped visit record types are now displayed in their sort order and default to the primary mapped type while preserving default settings for unmapped accounts. The custom Agentforce interface continued to display an incorrect agent label after switching to a different agent. | The interface now refreshes immediately upon switching to display the name and label of the selected agent. The Add Discussion action remained available after a default discussion was created, even when the discussion record type was configured to allow only one discussion. | The action is now hidden when a discussion already exists and Limit to 1 Discussion is enabled.

findings.name: Version 262.6.0
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description Account Management | The Edit action was not appearing on the Account Territory Fields component for users with edit permissions. | Updated component permission evaluation to render the Edit action on the Account Territory Fields component. Renamed custom field labels for Contact Point Address and Contact Point Email weren't updated after syncing metadata. | Updated metadata sync processing so renamed custom field labels now display correctly. Device sync transaction payloads for Account Filters included unnecessary column label data, increasing file size and slowing down syncs. | Removed redundant column label data from device sync files to reduce data size and speed up syncing. Editing Contact Point Email or Contact Point Phone records directly from the details page allowed multiple records to be incorrectly set as Primary. | Added validation rules to detail pages to ensure only one contact point can be set as Primary at a time. The Business License section appeared in the filter field picker even when the field set was configured as None in the Admin Console. | Updated filter settings so the Business License section is correctly hidden when set to None. The Account detail page displayed raw picklist API codes instead of human-readable labels in the Specialties section. | Updated specialty field rendering logic to resolve and display localized picklist labels instead of API values. Account Search | Standard fields such as Phone Numbers, Social Identifiers, and National Provider Identifiers were missing from Advanced Search results when querying business licenses. | Updated search result layouts to display all configured standard fields for business license searches. Activity Timeline | Multiple Account and Activity Timeline screens on iPad displayed hard-coded English strings and inconsistent date formats. | Fixed the localization issues and standardized date formatting across Account tabs, rating options, and Activity Timeline calendar filters. Calendar | Submitted visits temporarily appeared as Completed on the calendar before reverting to Planned status after a sync, causing status discrepancies and duplicate entries. | Unified visit completion status detection across calendar views, previews, and record editing checks to maintain consistent Completed status even when synchronization is pending. Event Management | Actions were displayed inconsistently in Participant Type related lists. Some participant types were missing edit and delete icons, while others had non-functional delete options. | Updated participant related list rendering to display edit and delete icons consistently based on user permissions and restored record deletion functionality. Adding attendees to Managed Events caused sync transactions to stall in In Progress status, resulting in duplicate attendee creation during subsequent manual syncs. | Updated attendee invitation count validation rules to prevent sync transaction stalls and duplicate record creation. The Subject Assignment component displayed a basic record creation form instead of the interactive subject selection table available on desktop site. | Implemented the interactive subject selection table component to provide consistent user experience. The Sign In Sheet Table exhibited styling discrepancies, including missing header backgrounds, incorrect table background colors, and typography non-compliance with design standards. | Updated Sign In Sheet Table styling and typography to strictly adhere to standard Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS) guidelines. Adding a Write-In attendee with a Participant Response Type of Invited to a Managed Event caused synchronization transactions to fail. | Updated the synchronization logic for Write-In attendees with Invited response status to ensure successful server synchronization. Synchronization transactions failed when adding an existing event participant a second time under a different Participant Type. | Updated synchronization logic to validate and synchronize duplicate participant records added with different participant roles. When adding colleagues or experts, an unnecessary System Generated Filter button was displayed that generated permission error messages. | Removed the unnecessary filter button from the selection interface to match desktop site behavior and eliminate error messages. Action buttons to add subject, participants, or estimated expenses were missing on newly created Managed Events until a manual sync was performed. | Updated event page initialization to render all configured action buttons immediately upon record creation without requiring a manual sync. The Done button on the Sign In Detail screen remained disabled even after capturing a signature. | Updated the button styling logic so the Done button enabled after a signature is captured. The checklist popover on the Financials/Expenses tab didn't match standard UI patterns. | Updated checklist popover styling and alignment to conform to standard application UI patterns. The Uneven Allocation toggle was missing from the Allocate Expense screen, preventing users from splitting expenses unevenly among attendees. | Added the Uneven Allocation toggle to the Allocate Expense screen. General | Hyperlinks in Rich Text components did not respond to single taps and could only be opened with a long press. | Updated Rich Text components so external and new-window links open with a single tap. Key Account Management | The Edit action was missing for Assessment Task records accessed from the Action Plan related list under Account Plan Objectives. | Enabled the Edit action for Assessment Task records in Account Plan related list. Surveys | The survey screen experienced layout flickering, vertical jitter on rating selection, and unexpected scrolling when changing question inputs. | Improved native input rendering for survey components to eliminate flickering and jitter, ensuring stable screen positions during updates. Visit Management | Tapping Add Discussion on the Visit Detail caused an error for users with only one assigned record type. | Fixed the background caching error so the discussion form fields now load and appear correctly. Sync transactions relied on redundant workaround logic to bypass backend validation triggers. | Streamlined sync transaction routines by removing legacy client-side workarounds, resulting in faster and more reliable synchronization. The Edit Visitors button was hidden when visibility rules were applied, and the visitor selection modal failed to preselect existing visitors beyond the first page, leading to duplicate record creation. | Updated the component visibility rule evaluation so the Edit Visitors button appears correctly, and ensured all existing visitors are preselected. The Next Visit Objective Type picklist on Provider Visits on iPad displayed all field picklist values instead of restricting values based on the assigned record type. | Corrected metadata record type resolution for Provider Visits to ensure picklist values are properly filtered according to configured record type restrictions.

findings.name: Version 262.4.0
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description Consent Management | The Capture Consent quick action was missing from the Visit detail page. Although the quick action was configured for Account and Visit creation flows, it was inadvertently omitted from the Visit Record page. | Added the Capture Consent quick action layout and metadata configuration to the Visit Record page. Verified that metadata access and SOQL queries run properly in the mobile at run time to prevent layout loading errors. General | High volumes of uncompressed log uploads from the iOS app caused excessive daily API usage and high server error rates (HTTP 503). | Refactored log upload logic to batch logs at 200 records per API call and enabled gzip compression, keeping payload sizes well within platform limits. Added bounded retry handling for HTTP 429, 503, and 504 status codes to prevent request storms and protect the daily API quota while preventing log loss. Uploading databases larger than 1 GB from an iPad crashed the app due to a Firebase Performance NSURLSession instrumentation conflict that triggered a duplicate call to the URL session completion handler. | Fixed the completion handler invocation in SFRestAPI.send to prevent double-execution during large payload transfers. Sync Management | When Enhanced Mobile Sync was enabled, visit data (including samples, DTP, marketing items, and select addresses) was missing from the Visit SPA view. | Corrected the Enhanced Mobile Sync database-mapping logic so all record fields are fully captured during bulk uploads, preventing sparse fields from saving as NULL. Also, removed redundant key transformations to streamline sync performance.

findings.name: Version 262.2.0
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description Calendar | In the Calendar view, account names weren't using the Custom Formula field configuration. | Updated the account name configuration lookup so the calendar view correctly reads and renders custom formula field definitions. Event Management | Managed events created outside business hours saved locally but consistently failed during server sync. | Enforced client-side business hours validation during event creation and editing, showing an immediate error message on the mobile app to prevent non-syncable records from saving. Users were unable to complete expense-related tasks on Managed Events due to a permission validation failure on Estimated Expense records. | Corrected the entity association logic for expense workflows to ensure permission checks succeed and users can complete expense operations on Managed Events. Users experienced an error during initial data synchronization after logging into the mobile application, requiring them to manually tap Retry. | Improved initial sync initialization and error handling so that first-time log-ins complete data synchronization smoothly without manual intervention. Tapping the Print button on a Managed Event Sign-In Sheet on iPad redirected to a browser with a "Page does not exist" error. | Integrated native iPad printing capabilities into the mobile app, allowing users to print or save event sign-in sheets directly without redirection. On Managed Event records, content on the Related tab was overlapped and obstructed by the Subject Assignment section. | Adjusted page layout positioning and scrolling boundaries to ensure all related records are fully visible and accessible on mobile. Attendees added to a Managed Event on web didn't display in the mobile app, causing attendee status discrepancies. | Updated data synchronization logic to ensure attendees added on web properly sync and reflect accurately on mobile. Managed Events could be saved with an End Date and Time earlier than the Start Date and Time, resulting in synchronization errors. | Added client-side date and time validation to prevent saving events with invalid time ranges and display an immediate validation message. Managed Events created during Time Off Territory (TOT) periods could be saved without warning, failing only when submitted for approval later. | Enforced Time Off Territory (TOT) overlap validation during event creation and editing on mobile to inform users of schedule conflicts immediately. Users couldn't add colleagues to Managed Events due to an inaccessible field error on Participant Role. | Updated field accessibility handling for Participant Role, allowing users to successfully add colleagues to Managed Events. Tapping the Save button didn't submit or save changes when editing details on a Managed Event record on mobile. | Updated mobile event configuration mappings and event handlers to ensure updates to Managed Event details are properly saved. The Sign In Sheet on Managed Events didn't indicate when an attendee was already signed in, allowing duplicate sign-in entries. | Added clear visual status indicators and disabled the Sign In button for previously signed-in attendees to prevent duplicate entries. General | The Account tab was taking over two minutes to load in environments with large account datasets. | Optimized mobile query execution, data caching, and implemented incremental loading for the Account tab. Account lists now load within expected time frames. The app was crashing immediately after a data sync. | Enhanced error handling and memory management within the sync completion workflow, preventing app crashes and ensuring stable background sync processing across large datasets. The mobile app crashed unexpectedly when downloading Content Version files (CLM documents). | Updated underlying mobile SDK dependencies to resolve the download failure and ensure app stability when opening CLM documents. Admin Console settings configured for the mobile application (such as View Online, default browser, and Kanban view) were not being enforced on iPad devices. | Fixed setting persistence and configuration decoding to ensure that all Mobile Admin Console settings are accurately applied on iPad. Records updated while working offline didn't immediately reflect updated data in Mobile Lightning Web Components (LWCs). | Corrected offline cache invalidation and component re-rendering to ensure Mobile LWCs accurately display modified data while offline. Intelligent Content | Opening the Email wizard from Account Quick Actions on iPad caused significant UI freezes due to unthrottled background template downloads. Furthermore, going to template selection before downloads finish showed an incorrect "Data Not Available" message. | Optimized background template downloading by limiting parallel network requests and fixing thread synchronization issues. Replaced the empty-state page with a clear download loading indicator to keep the UI smooth and responsive. Visit Management | Reusing the same pre-defined prompt in Visit Agent during a single session failed to inject the utterance after closing and reopening the Agentforce window. | Corrected session state resetting so pre-defined Visit Agent prompts can be clicked and injected multiple times within the same session. Required field asterisks configured on Provider Visit Product Discussion page layouts didn't appear on the mobile Visit Engagement screen. | Updated mobile UI rendering to properly display required field indicators (*), aligning field validation visual cues between web and mobile. Page layout requirement rules for the Channel field on Visit records were not enforced on mobile, and the Schedule Next Visit dialog incorrectly enforced required field checks. | Enforced page layout validation rules for the Channel field on Visit records, and updated the Schedule Next Visit window so the Channel field remains editable without being required, matching web behavior. Pre-Provider Visit Notes were not carried over from the last submitted Visit when creating a new Visit for an Account. | Updated Visit creation logic to automatically populate Pre-Provider Visit Notes from the previous Visit's objectives, maintaining field precedence rules and matching web behavior. On iPad devices connected to an external mouse and keyboard, clicking the overflow menu button on the Visit Engagement page caused the cursor to jump away, preventing selection. | Fixed pointer interaction handling on header components so users can seamlessly interact with overflow menus when using an external mouse on iPad. The mobile app crashed when submitting a Provider Visit if the Planned Start Time was set later than the Planned End Time. | Added time range validation checks to gracefully handle inverted time ranges and display a validation error instead of causing an app crash. When an iPad device language was set to a non-English locale, attempting to save a Visit on a weekday displayed an error stating the visit must be scheduled on a working weekday. | Updated working weekday validation to evaluate date components using Salesforce user locale settings instead of device language settings, allowing visits to be saved on working weekdays. Selecting a related address for a new Visit on mobile didn't automatically populate the Parent Organization ID upon initial selection. | Updated address selection logic to immediately resolve and populate the Parent Organization ID without requiring page refreshes.

findings.name: Version 260.7.0
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description General | Lightning Web Components using platformResourceLoader to load static resources failed with an error after upgrading the Life Sciences Cloud Mobile App. | Static resources now load consistently in LMR components.

findings.name: Version 260.6.0
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description Visit Management | When the list view filter uses a value from a lookup field, it doesn’t return records even when matching records exist. | The list view filter evaluation logic has been fixed to correctly apply conditions referencing related lookup fields, and the list view now returns the appropriate matching records. On a Visit Engagement page, Channel picklist values weren't filtered based on the selected record type. | The issue is fixed, and picklist values are now correctly filtered. When a sample limit template with warning mode was applied, incorrect warning message texts were displayed when the quantity exceeded the limit. | The issue is fixed, and the correct message texts are displayed. Activity Plan | The Activity Plan home page component only displays the Activity Plans by Products component on the iPad. | The Activity Plan homepage has been enhanced to display a new Activity Plan Progress component in addition to the older Activity Plan By Product component. Data Change Request | Data Change Request (DCR) inserts were failing due to field-level permission checks on fields like operationType and dataChangeInformation, even when the fields weren't modified. | The issue is fixed by removing unnecessary internal permission checks during DCR creation to ensure DCR records are created successfully. Advanced Search | The Name field was missing on the Advanced Search window for HCO accounts, despite being correctly configured in the fieldset. | Updated the record type resolution logic to ensure HCO accounts correctly map to their specific record types, ensuring the Name field renders as expected in the Advanced Search window. HCP-related fields were not appearing in Advanced Search results, even though they were correctly displayed and functional during online searches. | The issue is fixed by aligning the Advanced Search field mapping with the online search configuration. This ensures that HCP-related fields are properly retrieved and rendered in the Advanced Search results. The dependent picklist shows the wrong states for a country when multiple states share the same value code component. | The issue is fixed by updating the component to filter state values using a unique identifier or a composite key (Country Code + State Code). This ensures the picklist correctly isolates states by their specific parent country, preventing overlapping or incorrect values from appearing in the UI.

findings.name: Version 260.4.0
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description Visit Management | When saving a visit with a product that has no State Distributor License (SDL) category, the visit fails to save if the selected address doesn’t have a valid SDL license. | The SDL validation logic is changed so that it no longer triggers for products without a State Distributor License (SDL) category, and the visit is now successfully saved. Because newer versions of the mobile app required expenses to be linked to a valid expense report, expenses couldn't be created or edited until they were linked to expense reports. | Expense Report is no longer a required field for expenses so you can create and edit expense entries without having to select an expense report. Lists and Filters | In the mobile app, certain list view filter conditions return no records even though matching records appear on web. | Fixed the list view filter conditions in the mobile app to ensure results are consistent with the web. Inquiry | The Inquiry action wasn’t rendering on the Home page due to a naming discrepancy between the web and the mobile app configuration. | Resolved the naming conflict and the Inquiry action is now visible on the Home page as expected. Presentations | When adding new pages to a custom presentation in the mobile app, tapping the + icon didn’t add the selected page as expected. Instead, users had to tap the page thumbnail directly to add it, resulting in an inconsistent user experience. | Users can now tap the + icon to add a page to a custom presentation, ensuring the behavior aligns with user expectations and provides a more intuitive, consistent experience. Intelligent Content | When reordering pages in a presentation, the page numbering did not update correctly. This could result in incorrect or duplicate page numbers being displayed. | Page numbers update automatically and accurately when pages are reordered. Users see the correct sequence reflected immediately, ensuring a smooth and reliable presentation experience. General | The Account Name field isn’t populated correctly in the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app when the Account Field to Display setting in Admin Console uses a custom formula field. | The Account Name field now reflects the correct value from the custom formula.

findings.name: Version 260.2.1
findings.detail: This patch contains fixes to ensure that the Life Sciences Cloud mobile app features work correctly. Feature | Issue | Description Visit Management | A deeplink with lightning/o/OBJECT_NAME/list format was not redirecting to the object list view. | A deeplink with lightning/o/OBJECT_NAME/list format now redirects to the object list view. The field for entering the Document ID in the pop-up isn’t visible on the Visit Engagement page. | The issue has been corrected, and the field for entering the Document ID is visible. No records are displayed when using special date strings like TODAY and THIS_WEEK in the list view filters. | The issue is corrected, and special date strings now return the correct results. The Visit Information section of the Attendee Visit Engagement page was editable. | The Visit Information section is now editable only on the parent Visit Engagement page and read-only in the Attendee Visit Engagement page. The text field for entering the Submit Delay Reason on a pop-up screen isn’t visible on the Visit Engagement page on mobile. | The issue is corrected, and the Submit Delay Reason field is now visible. Multi-select picklists for Product Discussions on the Visit Engagement page weren't supported in the mobile app. | The multi-select picklist field type is now displayed correctly in the Product Discussions section of the Visit Engagement page. While capturing a signature, the mobile app appeared unresponsive, even though it was still processing the capture. | A spinner now displays when the app is capturing a signature. Product messages weren't displayed by message groups even when message groups were set for the messages. | The issue has been fixed, and product messages are now displayed by message groups when those are set for messages. General | Mobile sync fails when users enable the Related Record Retrieve checkbox because the mobile client queries the Name field for related records, but some related objects don’t have a Name field, causing a sync failure. | To enable sync to complete successfully, deselect the Related Record Retrieve checkbox to prevent the mobile client from adding Name fields for related objects. Planner | The Calendar was taking too long to load when the accounts had too many visit events. | Optimized the main database query to include child visit counts, eliminating the need for additional queries and significantly improving calendar load times. The Calendar crashes frequently, especially while loading, scrolling, and during drag-and-drop scheduling. | Fixed the underlying issues to prevent Calendar from crashing. Inquiry | The Recently Viewed related list on the Activity Plan and Inquiry objects displayed inconsistently between the web and iPad interfaces. On the web, it showed only a few records, while on the iPad, it correctly displayed all recently viewed records for the same user. | The Recently Viewed related list now displays items consistently across both web and iPad interfaces for Activity Plan and Inquiry objects.
